Element: Sun. VFX: to the sky: the rays, the orb, the motes, the forehead gem, the pendant and
the wing tips glow and step through gold, amber and white every 2 s; the halo turns once in 12
s; gold motes circle the shoulders; a ground ring of light; a sunlight trail while it hovers;
the flourish (every 12 s) is a hop and a full turn with the wings flared, the disk popping and
the orb leaping, the moment Effects.luau can hang a flare and a column of light on
